title: Native spatial Mo+S projected DOS for pristine and near-edge-vacancy Au top contacts

method.relationship_to_archived_plot: Retains the archived Mo+S atom projection and coordinate rotation. Correctly groups collocated projected rows by a 0.01 Angstrom tolerance and sums all Mo/S atom projections, rather than using rounded x values as dictionary keys. Unlike the old display, the new map uses native energy samples and piecewise-constant strips without quadratic interpolation or Gaussian smoothing.
method.origin_definition: Mo atom minimizing x^2+y^2+z^2, as in archived find_llc_atom.
method.grouping: Sort all Mo and S atoms by rotated x; append to a strip while |x - first_x_of_strip| <= 0.01 Angstrom. Use the arithmetic mean of atom x coordinates as strip center.
method.spatial_edges: Midpoints between adjacent strip centers; exterior edges extrapolate half the neighboring center spacing.
method.native_energy_edges: Midpoints between adjacent native energies; exterior edges extrapolate half the neighboring sample spacing.
method.spectrum: For every native energy, sum the DOS of all Mo and S atoms in a strip; divide by the strip Mo count and by hartree_to_ev.
method.normalization: Projected Mo+S spectral weight per Mo atom in the strip. P strips contain one Mo and two S; two F0 strips contain one Mo and one S. This is not a mean Mo-only DOS or a claim of identical local stoichiometry.
method.data_interpolation: none; native cells are piecewise constant, clipped only at the visible plot bounds

color_scale.units: states eV^-1 per Mo, including Mo and S projections
color_scale.clipping: no data values in the plotted window exceed the [0,7] color range

figure.Au_footprints: Recorded below from atomic projection extents; not drawn or interpreted as a precise interface plane.
figure.x_label: Position along device (Å); underlying coordinate is the archived rotated x recorded above.
figure.rendering: shape-rendering=crispEdges applies only to native map-cell groups to avoid vector-cell antialiasing seams.

units.conversion_check: The native endpoints ±0.0734986519335732 Hartree map to the input ±2 eV; inverse-energy DOS conversion preserves the integrated spectral weight.
units.fermi_reference: mFermiEnergy=[0,0], with both lead voltages zero. NanoDCAL energyRange for systems with leads is measured from the zero-bias lead chemical potential.

geometry_caveats: This is the preserved Au dataset explicitly used by dataAnalysis/PLot_For_publication_Au/fittedLDOS.py; not a new DFT calculation.
Original x cell length is 120.641 Angstrom; the archived plotting script uses Lx=108 Angstrom after its in-plane rotation.

F0 to F2 vacancy displacement is 5.484 Angstrom in original x (4.749 Angstrom in the script-rotated coordinate), while final-manuscript lateral distance labels use 2d=6.3 Angstrom. Do not infer those lateral distances from this derivative.
P has 318 atoms and F0/F10 have 316 atoms: each defective raw structure removes two S atoms, one near each contact.
Finite in-gap spectral weight and the native broadening/grid prevent a unique zero-DOS onset; the present figure does not separate broadening tails from physical interface states.
